text.autoconfig.autohome.title: Auto Home Config
Toggle the auto-home feature on/off. Manual trigger and reset also stop working while disabled.
Auto-teleport when health drops below this value (1-20). 6 = 3 hearts. Health exactly at this value does not trigger.
text.autoconfig.autohome.option.action.c: Sent when triggered. A leading slash uses the command channel (/spawn). Any other prefix, such as ".home" or "!sell", is sent as chat so server plugins can pick it up.
text.autoconfig.autohome.option.cooldown: How long auto-triggering stays blocked after the command is sent.
Clear the cooldown once it expires.
Clear the cooldown as soon as health recovers above the threshold.
Allow the manual reset key to clear the cooldown.
text.autoconfig.autohome.option.feedback: Send a chat message when a command is executed or a problem is detected.
Notify in chat when the cooldown is cleared and the mod is ready again.
Show the remaining cooldown on screen.
Screen corner used for the cooldown countdown.
text.autoconfig.autohome.option.debug.de: Write trigger and reset events to the game log.
chat.autohome.reset_done: AutoHome: Cooldown reset, ready to teleport again
chat.autohome.no_command: AutoHome: No valid command configured, nothing was sent
